install.notes: The fake backend needs neither the clone nor its dependencies and runs on the SDK's Python 3.10+. The declared sim backend is the upstream abc_sim.make_env, which needs mujoco~=3.8.0 and gymnasium>=1.1 (pyproject.toml:15, :21) and the simulator assets downloaded by prepare.py --sim (abc_sim/README.md:181-185). The gate never installs or imports the upstream package; the sim backend was not run.
